key_insight: OpenAI4S makes AI scientific work more reliable by treating each scientific action as executable code within persistent sessions, so experiments stay inspectable, resumable, and reproducible.
engineering_relevance: For materials discovery workflows, this design improves long-horizon automation by preserving provenance, checkpoints, and executable state across iterative computational studies.
method: Persistent Python and R kernels execute complete code cells as scientific actions.
Append-only Action Ledger plus per-cell records, versioned artifacts, environment logs, and workspace checkpoints preserve provenance and enable recovery/branching.
Sandboxing, permission controls, and code/trajectory screening add safety layers.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on 36 research scenarios across retrosynthesis, molecular dynamics, protein design/mutation, catalyst screening, and mineral spectroscopy; OpenAI4S scored 7.83 overall versus 5.7–6.4 for a general-purpose coding harness.
watch_item: Environment specification and full rerunnability remain weak, so end-to-end reproducibility is still not fully solved.
paper_title: OpenAI4S: Code as Action, Science as Sessions
